requirements.title: Who may open a change
requirements.rationale: A contributor must be able to propose work from a fork into a workspace they can only read, and nobody else may write on their behalf.

criteria.action: open the change and return the change object
criteria.contract: HTTP 201 with a change object whose workspace_slug is :slug, number is a positive integer, ref is '<slug>#<number>', state is 'open', version is 1, source is {workspace_slug, branch} as resolved, and author is {actor_type, actor_id, username} of the credential

requirements.rationale: A change must never miss a head of its branch, and the client must not have to do anything for it.

criteria.contract: RecordVersion returns the new version; after commit the change reads back with version n+1 and the new values, and GET …/versions lists versions 1..n+1 in order with the earlier versions unchanged
